stories.title: 75% of Rockstar’s workers have voted against a union deal
stories.summary: The workers rejected a deal that would recognize the Rockstar Game Workers Union

sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: 75% of Rockstar’s workers have voted against a union deal
sources.text: The workers rejected a deal that would recognize the Rockstar Game Workers Union UK-based Rockstar workers have voted against unionizing. The IWGB, a union representing some Rockstar workers, has confirmed that workers rejected a deal that would recognize the Rockstar Game Workers Union. The two-week ballot, which ran from 12 to 26 November, overlapped with the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 . The results were roughly 25% in favor of recognizing the union, and 75% against, with the vast majority of its around 1,600 employees participating. Recognition would have established a formal framework for workers to negotiate collectively over pay, overtime, bonuses, leave, pensions, and the impact of AI and redundancies. The result does not prevent Rockstar workers from organizing with the IWGB or exercising their trade union rights, but means management will not be formally committed to regular meetings with union representatives. The union is also able to continue representing individual members. The IWGB says that this has not dissuaded them, and they will continue to try and “win the trust” of Rockstar employees. “For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society – this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for,” a statement from the IWGB reads. “Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen. “Whilst we haven’t emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening,” the statement continues. “We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions will lead us. “A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But it’s one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We’ll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against Al and layoffs.” In its own statement,Â Rockstar Games said it was âextraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we’ve built together and the launch of GTA 6.â âThis result reflects our team’s strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong,” said Jennifer Kolbe, head of publishing. “As we look ahead, we’re excited to build on all we’ve accomplished together.â This comes amid an employment tribunal into alleged union busting at Rockstar . In 2025, Rockstar dismissed 34 workers who were active in the workplace’s union efforts. They say they were let go as part of an effort to stop these efforts, whereas Rockstar says they were dismissed for leaking confidential information .

sources.name: Kotaku
sources.title: Union Vote Fails In Landslide At GTA 6 Studio Rockstar Games As 75 Percent Of Devs Vote No
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 Rockstar Games Union Rockstar Games will not be forced to formally recognize a union at the Grand Theft Auto 6 studio after its developers based in the UK voted overwhelmingly against the initiative. The weeks-long voting process played out as Rockstar launched the open-world hit to over 30 million sales in its first day . Voting began on November 12 and concluded today on November 26 . Workers at Rockstar Games voted 75 percent against the recognition agreement with the IWGB Game Workers Union. The initiate would have formalized collective bargaining efforts around things like overtime, bonuses, layoffs, and AI. Developers in favor of unionizing can still work with the IGWB, but there will be no regular meetings with management to hash out new policies. “We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we’ve built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6,” Rockstar head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe said in a statement shared with Kotaku . “This result reflects our team’s strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we’re excited to build on all we’ve accomplished together.â The IWGB Game Workers Union pushing the vote released the following statement: For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society – this isnât a sign to retreat, itâs a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favor of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognize we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. Weâre ready to put in the effort to make that happen. Whilst we havenât emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us. A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But itâs one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. Weâll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against AI and layoffs. The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands. The vote comes roughly a year after Rockstar fired dozens of developers it accused of gross misconduct and breaking confidentiality rules around the development of GTA 6 . The fired workers accused the studio of union busting, which it has denied, and a legal fight has been ongoing over the last 12 months at a labor tribunal. A final judgement in that case is still pending. As recently as this month, members of both sides of the dispute were testifying on the record for the case. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Rockstar Games employees vote against union recognition
sources.text: Rockstar Games employees have voted against official recognition of the Rockstar Game Workers Union, with 93.2 percent of staff participating in the vote. 25 percent of those who participated voted to recognise the union, while 75 percent voted against. If it had been approved, it would have been the largest recognised union in the UK video game industry by a large margin. While the union will still exist and organise, Rockstar Games will not have to recognise the union as a representing body for staff at the studio, and is not obligated to attend regular meetings with the body. Jennifer Kolbe, head of publishing at Rockstar Games told Eurogamer: "We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 . This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together." The Rockstar Union also released a statement following the outcome of this vote, saying Rockstar employees will continue to organise despite the lack of recognition. It reads: "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society - this isn't a sign to retreat, it's a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We're ready to put in the effort to make that happen. "Whilst we haven't emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us. "A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But it's one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We'll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against Al and layoffs. "The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands." Rockstar employees represented by the union are still awaiting the verdict from the Rockstar Games vs IWGB employment tribunal legal case, of which the final verdict is still pending . This case was kicked off by the sudden firing of employees present in a union Discord server. The employees claim this was an attempt at union busting by Rockstar, while the company denies this, saying it was for breaking confidentiality agreements.

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Following GTA 6 release, Rockstar workers vote against union recognition deal
sources.text: "This isn't a sign to retreat, it's a sign to double down on what we stand for," says the IWGB Rockstar Games Workers Union A week on from GTA 6 's launch, devs at Rockstar Games have officially voted overwhelmingly against a union recognition deal, but those in favor say "we'll keep fighting." That there was a 93.2% turnout in the ballot, which began earlier this month, and of those voters, 1,163 employees voted against the deal, while 381 voted in favor. That's a split of 75.3% to 24.7%. Rockstar Games head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe, says in a statement sent to GamesRadar+ that "we are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6," adding: "This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together." In a statement shared by Vertical Slice , the IWGB notes that the vote result will "not prevent Rockstar workers from organizing with the IWGB or exercising their trade union rights" in the future, "but means management will not be formally committed to regular meetings with union representatives." The IWGB Rockstar Games Workers Union also encourages those in favor of the deal not to back down, but to "double down on what we stand for." In a statement sent to GamesRadar+, it says: "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society – this isn't a sign to retreat, it's a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favor of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognize we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We're ready to put in the effort to make that happen. "Whilst we haven't emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening," it continues. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more "People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us." It says that while "a recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy," it sees this as "one route of many," adding: "At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We’ll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against AI and layoffs. "The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands." A group of Rockstar Games workers began seeking union recognition back in June , with devs hoping for "pay transparency, fairer crunch practices and better flexible working arrangements." This came after Rockstar was accused of union busting late last year following the dismissal of over 30 employees. This July, Rockstar confirmed it would "arrange to meet" union reps to discuss voluntary recognition – a meeting that the Rockstar union called "a step in the right direction." GTA 6 devs are "worried about getting laid off" even after "working on the biggest game of all time." sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.title: Majority of Rockstar Workers Vote Against Unionization
sources.text: A new update has revealed that 75% of Rockstar UK workers voted against unionization. For those unaware, a vote was scheduled for November 2026 that could have made Rockstar Games the biggest video game union in the world. The unionization would have covered over 1,600 workers out of the company’s reported 4,700 employees. However, the workers decided to vote against unionization. A recent post on X (formerly Twitter) by Jason Schreier reveals that 75% of Rockstar’s UK employees have voted against unionization under the Independent Workers’ Union of Great Britain. In a statement, Jennifer Kolbe, the head of publishing, expressed pride in the team’s efforts to build a strong culture and successfully launch their biggest game yet, Grand Theft Auto 6. The statement adds that the voting results demonstrate the team’s preference for maintaining a direct relationship, collaboration, and open dialogue with the company. Here’s the entire statement by Jennifer Kolbe: “We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we’ve built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. This result reflects our team’s strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we’re excited to build on all we’ve accomplished together.” Prior to this, there have been many exchanges between the IWGB and Rockstar regarding unionization. The body alleged that 31 employees in the UK studio were let go due to a case of union busting, while Rockstar claimed they were fired for sharing confidential information. Some devs were also hoping to unionize before the release of GTA 6, but that didn’t happen either. What are your thoughts on Rockstar workers voting against unionization? Leave your thoughts down in the comments, and join the official Insider Gaming Discord server . For more from Insider Gaming, read about GTA 6 reportedly becoming the biggest physical launch in the UK since 2019 . Don’t forget to sign up for our weekly newsletter .

sources.title: Rockstar workers vote overwhelmingly against union recognition
sources.text: The IWGB says efforts will continue, but with only 25% of Rockstar workers voting in favor, there's a long way to go. After two weeks of voting that bracketed the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 , Rockstar Games employees have voted overwhelmingly against a recognition agreement with the IWGB Game Workers Union. 25% of Rockstar employees voted in favor of the recognition agreement, the union said, while 75% voted against it. 1,544 employees took part in the vote, representing a turnout of just over 93%. Rockstar workers actually founded a union earlier this year—the Rockstar Game Workers Union, a subsidiary of the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain—and it will continue to operate as it has. The IWGB said the outcome will not prevent Rockstar workers from organizing or exercising union rights, but the company will not be required to regularly meet with union representatives for collective bargaining or other relevant matters. Despite the vote, the union said it will continue with organizing efforts at Rockstar. "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society—this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognize we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues," the IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union said. "We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen. "Whilst we haven’t emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us." The power to shape our working lives has always been, and always will be, in our hands In a separate statement, Rockstar head of publishing Jennfer Kolbe said the studio is "extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6." From the creators of Edge: A free weekly videogame industry newsletter, featuring in-depth news, expert analysis and exclusive interviews "This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong," Kolbe said. "As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together." Rockstar, which said it worked with the IWGB to ensure employees were able to make an informed decision in a fair and transparent vote, came under fire in October 2025 for firing more than 30 employees, all of whom were members of a private trade union Discord channel. The IWGB called it " the most ruthless act of union busting in the history of the UK games industry ," while Rockstar says they were fired for leaking information about "upcoming and unannounced games." That matter is now before an employment tribunal ; closing submissions were made last week. sources.title: GTA 6 reinvigorates PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X console sales in the US, even at their inflated prices
sources.text: Despite the far higher prices of PlayStation and Xbox consoles today compared to their launch, or even the same period last year, both brands of console saw a significant boost in US sales leading up to the launch of this generation's biggest game: Grand Theft Auto 6. In the week ending 14th November, PS5 hardware unit sales registered a 2.4x increase over the same week last year. Xbox wasn't far behind, seeing a 2.3x increase in its own unit sales. That's according to industry analyst Mat Piscatella at Circana , who pulled the data from Circana's retail tracking service, which covers the US retail market. The PS5 Pro only accounted for less than 10 percent of the PlayStation's total unit sales, by the way, which Piscatella noted was "a LOT better than it has been in recent weeks", and seemingly the result of increased supply. GTA 6, of course, released on 19th November, so the surge in console hardware sales was clearly driven by the rush to attain consoles before the game came out. And while the GTA 6-driven demand isn't surprising, it's worth noting how much more expensive PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles are today. A standard PS5 today costs $650, compared to $550 a year ago. The PS5 Pro saw a big jump from $750 last November to $900 today. The base Xbox Series X jumped from $650 last year to $800 today, while Series S now costs $500, up from $400. Even Switch 2, where GTA 6 is not available, saw a notable boost of 40 percent in hardware sales over the same period, driven by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and the special edition Zelda Switch 2 console . Circana's November US video game market report, which releases in December, is already one of the most anticipated this year, for digesting and documenting the GTA 6 effect. Worldwide, GTA 6 sold more than 32.5m copies in one day , making Rockstar's parent company Take-Two $3.79bn (£2.89bn) in revenue. We haven't had any updated official sales figures since; but estimates suggest the sales figure could be well into the 40-millions. Perhaps Rockstar is waiting to hit the nice round 50m sales mark before announcing it. If you're playing GTA 6, you may want to keep Eurogamer's GTA 6 walkthrough to hand. It has plenty of very helpful guides covering the game's main missions, as well as explainers for mechanics like romance and the criminal profile , and even cheats for when you finish the game.

sources.text: Famitsu has published its estimated physical game software data for Japan for the week of November 16, 2026 to November 22, 2026. Grand Theft Auto VI for PlayStation 5 , which is sold as a code in a box at retail, was the highest selling release of the week, opening at 200,759 retail copies sold. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 placed second with an additional 35,295 retail copies sold. On the hardware side, the PlayStation 5 family sold 41,472 units, Switch 2 sold 36,817 units, the Switch family sold 4,362 units, and the Xbox Series family sold 751 units. sources.title: Retail Hell coming to PS5, Xbox Series, and Switch
sources.text: Publisher Feardemic and developer LEAP Game Studios will release simulation horror game Retail Hell for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series , and Switch , the companies announced. A release date was not announced. Retail Hell first launched for PC via Steam on May 21. Here is an overview of the game, via its Steam page : Welcome to Retail Hell , the most “beloved” convenience store in Purgatory, where nothing stays stocked, no customer is human, and every shift lasts forever. You play as an overworked clerk stuck in a literal dead-end job. Each shift forces you to juggle supernatural customer service, collapsing inventory, and the unsettling mystery of how you ended up here. In Retail Hell , customer service is eternal. Good luck, management does not believe in refunds.

sources.title: Até quanto pagar na Black Friday 2026?
sources.text: A Black Friday é uma das melhores oportunidades de compras do ano, mas nem todo desconto anunciado representa uma economia real. Para aproveitar a data, é importante saber quanto cada produto já custou e qual valor pode ser considerado uma boa oferta . Consultar o menor preço histórico antes de comprar ajuda a evitar falsas promoções e permite fazer escolhas mais inteligentes. Neste guia, o TecMundo traz algumas referências de preços para produtos populares , de celulares e notebooks a eletrodomésticos, para ajudar você a aproveitar melhor os descontos desse período. As buscas por tecnologia, celulares, televisores, eletrodomésticos e produtos para casa costumam ganhar força na Black Friday, especialmente entre consumidores que planejam compras de maior valor. Por isso, saber até que valor é vantajoso pagar no aparelho novo ajuda muito a fazer um bom negócio na hora de fechar a compra. Confira também Confira os cupons de Black Friday para resgatar já! Confira os cupons de Black Friday para resgatar já! Usamos ferramentas que monitoram buscas na internet, como Semrush e Google Trends, e agentes de inteligência artificial para montar um guia prático. A lista tem produtos com maior volume de buscas e a média de preços nos últimos 12 meses. O PlayStation 5 é um dos produtos mais desejados por quem quer aproveitar a Black Friday para investir em entretenimento. Para o PS5 Slim Digital, vale buscar ofertas próximas de R$ 2.500, enquanto a versão com leitor de discos pode ser interessante na faixa de R$ 2.800. Lembrando que o leitor também pode ser adquirido separadamente para modelos Slim. Já o PS5 Pro , que oferece desempenho gráfico aprimorado, merece atenção quando estiver em torno de R$ 5.000. Um notebook com configurações intermediárias pode atender muito bem às tarefas de trabalho, estudo, navegação e entretenimento, sem exigir um investimento elevado na Black Friday deste ano. O Dell Inspiron 15 com Intel Core i5, SSD de 512 GB, 8 GB de RAM e Windows 11 é uma opção versátil para a rotina. Se aparecer próximo a R$ 3.000 na promoção deste ano, vale a compra. O Acer Aspire 5 com i5, 512 GB SSD, 8 GB de RAM e Windows 11 é uma alternativa ao modelo da Dell e pode ser uma boa compra se for encontrado por volta de R$2.800. Televisores também estão em alta nas buscas relacionadas à maior data promocional do ano. Os modelos da Samsung e da LG são os mais almejados. A Samsung QN70H de 55 polegadas, com tecnologia Mini LED, é uma opção interessante para quem busca qualidade de imagem. Se aparecer esse modelo por algo em torno de R$ 3.400, pode crer que é uma boa oportunidade. A LG QNED70 de 55 polegadas oferece resolução 4K e recursos inteligentes, e é um bom investimento se encontrada por valores próximos de R$ 2.200 com os descontos de Black Friday. A busca por smartphones premium na Black Friday aumenta. A linha Galaxy S e o modelo mais recente do iPhone são sempre mais visados, mas é preciso saber os valores que tem sido cobrados por eles para fazer um investimento inteligente. Com opções para diferentes perfis, a linha iPhone 17 tem desde modelos mais acessíveis até versões Pro voltadas para desempenho e fotografia. Preste bastante atenção aos preços para não acabar confundindo as alternativas disponíveis. A família Galaxy S25 oferece diferentes combinações de desempenho, câmeras e recursos de inteligência artificial. Buscar ofertas realmente sabendo os preços máximos ideais ajuda bastante no processo de compra. Os tablets também são muito desejados em datas promocionais. Se você está em busca de um modelo para estudar, trabalhar ou para entretenimento, temos algumas sugestões. Mesmo sendo de duas gerações anteriores, a linha Galaxy Tab S10 segue relevante e reúne tablets para diferentes necessidades. Analise bem os recursos e especificações de cada opção para ver qual combina melhor com o seu perfil antes de fechar a compra na BF deste ano. O iPad 11” com chip A16 é uma opção para quem busca bom desempenho em produtividade, navegação e entretenimento, sendo especialmente indicado para os usuários e fãs do ecossistema Apple. Na categoria eletrodomésticos a geladeira é o mais desejado, e não é à toa. Investir em um eletro caro como este na Black Friday ajuda a reduzir bastante o investimento. Com capacidade próxima de 480 litros, a Electrolux TF7 1 é indicada para famílias que precisam de espaço e praticidade, podendo ser uma ótima aquisição com desconto na BF. A Brastemp BRM45JK combina capacidade de 375 litros e praticidade para o dia a dia. Se aparecer nessa faixa, pode representar uma boa oportunidade de investimento. Outro eletro muito desejado nesta época de calor é o ar-condicionado. Aqui, além dos valores, é importante conferir o consumo de energia e outras especificações. O Gree G-Side de 12.000 BTUs é uma alternativa interessante para quem busca boa climatização a preço justo e ainda quer economizar com os descontos da promoção. O modelo LG de 9.000 BTUs pode atender ambientes menores, sendo recomendado para quartos ou salas pequenas. Praticidade na cozinha também fica em alta na Black Friday, e o micro-ondas está entre os itens mais buscados, principalmente modelos compactos. O Electrolux ME23B conta com recursos de descongelamento e funções práticas para o uso cotidiano, sendo uma compra interessante se for encontrado na casa dos R$ 480. Se disponível por cerca de R$ 480, o modelo inox Brastemp de 20 litros com funções de pré-preparo, que podem agilizar tarefas na cozinha, é uma alternativa interessante que não pesa no bolso. Além de praticidade, a air fryer oferece uma alimentação mais saudável, por isso se tornou o eletroportátil com mais procura em datas promocionais. Se estiver nessa faixa, a Mondial Family de 4 litros é uma boa escolha para preparar porções de alimentos com praticidade em um modelo que cabe no orçamento. A WAP Barbecue Digital reúne recursos que ampliam as possibilidades de preparo de carnes suculentas em um churrasco, ainda mais se estiver nesta faixa de preç

sources.title: Players discover over 1,500 individual buildings you can enter in GTA 6, nearly 28% of all buildings on the map
sources.text: One GTA 6 player has put in the legwork and found that a shocking number of buildings across Leonida are freely accessible. Per a Reddit post by Aileos , 1,563 of the game's 5,588 buildings can be entered, coming in at 27.97 percent of structures in the game. Some of those are ones you'd expect of course: stores, banks, and the like. But plenty of them may surprise you. The next time you're walking across a neighbourhood, pick a house and just walk inside… in-game, of course. A funny quirk with this discovery is its relation to previous leaks for Grand Theft Auto 6. Back in 2025 it was claimed that over 700 buildings can be freely entered in GTA 6 , something that received ample doubt from those anticipating the Rockstar release. Take this comment from user Macklaviel: "There's a difference between proven true and not proven wrong yet. 700 interiors would be astonishingly good but it sets the expectations too high and it realistically will be way less than that." Plenty of the best secrets in GTA 6 can be found off the beaten trail. Random drops of illicit goods can be found all over the place. So, if you're having a blast making your way through the game, take an hour or so just to wander around the place and take in the scenery. If you are in the market for some help through the game, Eurogamer's GTA 6 walkthrough is a great source of helpful information. Likewise, our page on all the GTA 6 cheats is a great help for those in need.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Someone counted all 5,588 buildings in GTA 6, and it turns out you can go inside 28% of them
sources.text: Maybe even more will open up for Online, too. Grand Theft Auto 6 hasn't even been out for a week yet, and someone has already done the math on how many buildings in the whole of Leonida you can actually walk into. For those of you who are curious: it's 1,563 buildings. That is frankly ridiculous. I don't think I've ever been inside 1,563 different buildings in my entire life, although I am a creature of habit, so that could explain things. The player who shared these stats, Aileos , does note that there are 5,588 buildings in total, so the enterable buildings only account for a fraction of that, just over 25%. There are some who will look at this with a glass-half-empty perspective, and I get it. This world is so cool, it's easy to want more of it, but as another player points out , "This would've sent us into psychosis a few years back". Sometimes it's better to focus on what we have rather than what we don't have. After all, how many buildings will you realistically enter in your GTA 6 playthrough? Probably not 1,563. We've spent the past week here in the PC Gamer Slack channel marvelling at just how many random encounters you can stumble across in GTA 6. Some of us have found sentient NPCs. One of us was actually recognised by a convenience store clerk who then asked to get robbed, and I think we've all seen videos of the furry rescue mission. But just because this world already has loads of awesome activities, it doesn't mean we aren't hoping for more. A massive casino and go-kart track have been spotted by players, both of which have huge "Coming Soon" signs draped outside of them. These buildings could be lying in wait for GTA 6 Online, or they could be added to singleplayer sometime in the future. sources.title: Can You Continue Playing GTA 6 After The Ending?
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 has as many as two dozen endings. It’s pretty insane, but then again, the entire game is bonkers. There’s so much to see and do, and the choices you make set up for that ending quite nicely. You really do get whatever you deserve in this game. That said, is there a facility that allows you to continue playing once you’ve completed GTA 6? When you hit your GTA 6 ending, are you free to go about Leonida finishing all the content you missed? There is no way to play GTA 6 after completing the story. It’s not like Red Dead Redemption 2, where you get to play as John Marston, and it’s not like Grand Theft Auto 5, where life just kind of goes on. When you hit the final mission of Grand Theft Auto 6, you’ll get whatever ending you’ve lined yourself up to receive; the credits will roll, and then you’ll be reverted to a point before you embarked on the final mission. That’s otherwise known as the ‘point of no return’ in GTA 6. This is where you’re given the opportunity to complete as much of the game as possible. But it’s not a ‘true’ endgame state where the story has ended, everyone recognizes that, and some paradigm shift happens to alter the world. It’s a time reversal that puts you back before that ultimate delivery. If you need to know anything else about Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure you stop by our full guides hub . sources.text: Todos disponíveis a partir de 1 de dezembro. Mande ver nos corrimãos, enfrente ícones e fuja de horrores além da compreensão com os Jogos Mensais PlayStation Plus de dezembro. Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 e Amnesia: The Bunker ficam disponíveis para todos os assinantes do PlayStation Plus* de terça-feira, 1º de dezembro, até segunda-feira, 4 de janeiro. Vamos conhecer um pouco mais sobre cada jogo. Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4 – Edição Cross-Gen | PS5, PS4 Avise a vizinhança e chame a galera do skate, porque a manobra não morreu: a clássica franquia volta com Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Tudo o que você curtia está de volta e repaginado, com mais skatistas, pistas novas, manobras mais pesadas, trilha sonora no volume máximo e muito mais. Caia nas pistas novas ou detone pelos cenários clássicos de Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 e Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 4, recriados em 4K**, com objetivos mais diretos e o clássico formato de 2 minutos. Jogue do seu jeito nos modos expandidos Criar um Skatista e Criar um Parque, agora com a opção inédita de criar objetivos personalizados para compartilhar com os amigos. Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 entrega uma experiência completa de Dragon Ball, com muita ação, batalhas intensas e diversas opções de personalização. Crie seu personagem, explore Conton City e treine com mestres icônicos da série para enfrentar inimigos poderosos e proteger o fluxo da História. Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 também traz modos multijogador online para enfrentar jogadores do mundo todo ou entrar em Batalhas de Invasão contra inimigos gigantes em equipe. Amnesia: The Bunker é um jogo de terror em primeira pessoa dos criadores de Soma e Amnesia. Sozinho em um bunker abandonado da Primeira Guerra Mundial, com apenas uma bala no tambor, você precisa encarar os horrores que espreitam no escuro. Descubra várias maneiras de sobreviver lá dentro. Na pele do soldado francês Henri Clément, você conta com um revólver, uma lanterna de dínamo barulhenta e poucos suprimentos para coletar e criar itens pelo caminho. Com elementos aleatórios e comportamento imprevisível, nenhuma partida é igual à outra. Caçado por uma ameaça constante que reage a cada passo e som, você precisa adaptar seu estilo de jogo para sobreviver a esse inferno. Cada decisão muda a forma como o jogo reage. Toda ação tem consequência. Última chance para adicionar os Jogos Mensais PlayStation Plus de novembro Assinantes PlayStation Plus têm até segunda-feira, 30 de novembro, para adicionar os Jogos Mensais de novembro à biblioteca: Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered e Monster Train 2. *A seleção PlayStation Plus pode variar de acordo com a região. Consulte PlayStation.com para mais detalhes. **A versão de PS5 roda em 4K nativo a 60 FPS no modo Fidelidade. A saída 4K exige um dispositivo ou tela compatível com 4K.

sources.title: PS Plus de dezembro: Sony revela três jogos mensais; confira a lista
sources.text: A Sony revelou nesta quinta-feira (26) a lista de jogos mensais do PlayStation Plus para dezembro de 2026. Os assinantes do serviço poderão resgatar três novos títulos, que incluem experiências de esporte, ação e terror. Os jogos estarão disponíveis a partir da próxima terça-feira (1º) para assinantes de todos os planos do serviço: Essential, Extra e Deluxe. O prazo para adicioná-los à biblioteca termina em 4 de janeiro de 2027. A clássica franquia de skate retorna com versões recriadas dos cenários de Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 e 4, gráficos em 4K, pistas inéditas e o tradicional formato de sessões de dois minutos. O título também amplia a seleção de skatistas e os modos de personalização de personagens e pistas, permitindo que os jogadores desenvolvam objetivos personalizados e compartilhem suas criações com amigos. Baseado na franquia criada por Akira Toriyama, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 permite que os jogadores criem seus próprios personagens, explorem Conton City e treinem com figuras icônicas do anime para proteger a linha do tempo da série. Além da campanha, o título oferece modalidades multijogador online e batalhas cooperativas contra inimigos gigantes. Desenvolvido pela Frictional Games, responsável por Soma e pela franquia Amnesia, o jogo de terror em primeira pessoa acompanha Henri Clément, um soldado francês preso em um bunker abandonado durante a Primeira Guerra Mundial. Com recursos limitados, o jogador precisa administrar seus equipamentos, explorar o ambiente e adaptar suas estratégias para sobreviver a uma criatura que reage aos sons e movimentos realizados durante a partida. Os assinantes do PlayStation Plus têm até segunda-feira (30) para adicionar os jogos mensais de novembro à biblioteca. São eles: Os jogos mensais resgatados permanecem disponíveis na biblioteca dos jogadores enquanto a assinatura do PlayStation Plus estiver ativa. sources.text: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4. In a PlayStation Blog post , Sony said Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker are December’s three titles. Will you be able to tear yourself away from GTA 6 to give either of these games a shot? Or perhaps you're after a palate cleanser after pumping 100 hours into Rockstar's epic? IGN's Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 review returned an 8/10. We said: "Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 proves yet again the series’ over-the-top skateboarding formula is totally timeless, even if some of the changes to THPS4 miss the mark and the soundtrack has been fumbled." Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, meanwhile, got a 7.5 back in 2017 . "Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is an ambitious , if rough-edged experience, with deceptively deep RPG and brawling elements," we said at the time. And our Amnesia: The Bunker review returned an 8. We said: "Amnesia: The Bunker is a smaller, more self-contained episode in the groundbreaking horror franchise that shows Frictional still has some chilling new tricks up their sleeves." It’s worth noting that PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, November 30 to add the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) to their library. sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

sources.title: Agradecemos por tornarem Grand Theft Auto VI o maior lançamento da história PlayStation
sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Foi incrível ver a comunidade PlayStation ao redor do mundo começar suas aventuras no estado de Leonida. Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. A empolgação e a paixão da comunidade tornaram este um momento verdadeiramente especial para todos nós. O lançamento de GTAVI marca um momento extraordinário para os jogos e o entretenimento, tornando-se o maior lançamento de um jogo na história de PlayStation, ao longo de três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles. Mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos vivenciaram a história de Jason e Lucia em Grand Theft Auto VI para PlayStation 5. A comunidade PlayStation se uniu de forma expressiva para vivenciar Grand Theft Auto VI durante seu lançamento e fim de semana de estreia. Confira alguns destaques do período de lançamento, encerrado em 22 de novembro de 2026*: Estas são apenas algumas das maneiras pelas quais vimos nossa comunidade PlayStation se unir em torno deste momento incrível no mundo dos jogos, e estamos empolgados para ver como vocês continuarão criando e compartilhando novas memórias e experiências nos próximos meses. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Com GTAVI, trabalhamos para oferecer a melhor experiência no console PS5 e proporcionamos aos jogadores uma forma memorável de celebrar o título, por meio de dois controles sem fio DualSense de edição limitada, inspirados em Vice City. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . É o entusiasmo de vocês que torna momentos como este tão significativos para todos nós. Mal podemos esperar para ver aonde suas aventuras em Leonida levarão vocês! *Todos os números baseiam-se em dados internos da SIE coletados de 19 de novembro de 2026 a 22 de novembro de 2026.

sources.title: Como jogar Grand Theft Auto VI pela nuvem e com Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI é compatível com o XBOX Cloud Gaming , então você pode jogar mesmo sem um console da geração atual. Com o XBOX Cloud Gaming, você pode jogar por streaming, direto da nuvem, no seu XBOX One ou no XBOX Series X|S, se quiser economizar espaço de armazenamento. Alguns planos do Game Pass incluem até 15 horas de jogo por mês na nuvem. Se precisar, você pode comprar horas adicionais para aproveitar um dos maiores jogos do ano no console que já tem. Ao jogar pela nuvem com o XBOX Cloud Gaming, o jogo usa as configurações gráficas do Xbox Series S. Você também pode usar o Remote Play para jogar Grand Theft Auto VI onde preferir. Com esse recurso, você transmite o jogo diretamente do seu console XBOX Series X|S para dispositivos que já tem, como celular, notebook, PC ou até um PC portátil para jogos, como o XBOX ROG Ally. Veja como configurar esses recursos. Para usá-los, você precisa de uma cópia de Grand Theft Auto VI comprada na Xbox Store : Para começar a jogar Grand Theft Auto VI pela nuvem, use um dos controles conectados ao seu console e siga estes passos: Sempre que possível, conecte o console à internet com um cabo Ethernet para obter a melhor qualidade de jogo. Mesmo em redes Wi-Fi de alta velocidade, a qualidade do áudio e do vídeo pode cair de vez em quando. Com o Remote Play, você pode transmitir o jogo do seu XBOX Series X|S para dispositivos que já tem, como celulares, tablets, PCs e PCs portáteis para jogos. Veja como ativar o recurso: Depois de ativar os recursos remotos no console, escolha em qual dispositivo quer jogar: Seja para economizar espaço jogando pela nuvem ou para retomar a partida de onde parou no seu PC portátil, o XBOX Cloud Gaming e o Remote Play oferecem mais opções de jogar Grand Theft Auto VI nos dispositivos que você já tem. Para saber mais, consulte a página do XBOX Cloud Gaming e a de Grand Theft Auto VI na Xbox Store.

sources.title: Digimon Alysion now available
sources.text: Digimon Alysion , the free-to-play mobile game based on Digimon Card Game , is now available for iOS via App Store and Android via Google Play in 183 countries and regions, Bandai Card Games announced . To celebrate surpassing 450,000 pre-registrations, all players will receive tickets that can be redeemed for game-exclusive cards, card packs, and a secret rare card, with more rewards planned. Here is an overview of the game, via Bandai Card Games: Digimon Alysion is finally here! Enjoy a brand-new Digimon card game world! And that’s not all! There’s plenty of other features that make the Digimon Card Game easy and fun to play! Whether you’re a seasoned veteran or just getting started, come and experience the Digimon Card Game by playing Digimon Alysion ! This application is distributed under the official rights from the license holder.

sources.title: Origament: A Paper Adventure now available for PS5, Switch
sources.text: Platformer adventure game Origament: A Paper Adventure is now available for PlayStation 5 and Switch for $9.99 / €9.99, publisher Assemble Entertainment and developer Space Sauce announced. Origament: A Paper Adventure first launched for PC via Steam on April 7. Here is an overview of the game, via Assemble Entertainment: Deep inside the Archive of Memory, forgotten letters sleep in endless drawers. But one little letter has other plans. Awakened by a mysterious spark, it escapes through a Time Glitch and sets off on an adventure across time and continents. Somewhere out there, someone is still waiting to read it. And that letter? That’s you! From moonlit gardens to the Wild West, every world has a story to tell and a clue to uncover. Are you ready to deliver the most important letter of all?

sources.title: Thrifty Business for Switch now available
sources.text: The Switch version of cozy thrift shop management game Thrifty Business is now available for $12.99, developer Spellgarden Games announced. Thrifty Business first launched for PC via Steam on May 18, followed by iOS and Android on November 10. Here is an overview of the game, via its Steam page : About There’s a brand new thrift store in town, and guess what? You’re in charge! In Thrifty Business , you’ll set up and manage your very own 90s-inspired vintage thrift shop. Search through boxes filled with pre-loved gems and use them to create gorgeous displays. Unlock furniture, decorations, wallpaper & floors to create a beautiful community space that brings everybody together! Adjust your layout and organize your shelves and racks to the finest detail. Group your wares by color, theme, purpose, or whatever you like. The more organized your store is, the more community points you’ll get to unlock new goodies! Customize the furniture, wallpaper, flooring, and decor to make your store as welcoming and cozy as possible. As business grows, you might even need to expand into the adjacent rooms! This is so much more than just a store. Listen to customer’s stories and try to fulfill their requests. You can also unlock and host hobbyist events, turning your business into a treasured third space for locals! What Thrifty Business Has in Store for You Laid-back management sim. Colorful 90s-inspired graphics. Over 500 different items to add to your shelves. Precision placing so you can organize exactly how you want. Customization options: furniture, decorations, wallpaper, and flooring. A quirky and unique cast of customers. What You Won’t Find on Our Shelves Stressful min-maxing to get the best possible profit. Setting item prices or haggling. Impatient customers that leave your store in anger. Watch a new trailer below.
